subject.title: Request: Add Discord reaction event support to Hooks system

question: Should OpenClaw add generic observation-only reaction hook names and payloads to the public plugin API now, and should the first implementation be Discord-only or cross-channel?
rationale: Source proves the missing hook surface, but hook names, payload shape, lazy enrichment, and cross-channel semantics are public plugin API decisions that code inspection cannot safely choose.

options.title: Approve Generic Observation Hooks
options.body: Add reaction_added and reaction_removed as observation-only public hooks with a shared payload shape, then wire Discord first with tests and docs while leaving room for Slack, Matrix, and WhatsApp parity.

options.title: Scope Discord First
options.body: Accept a Discord-first contract now, with explicit follow-up requirements so cross-channel payload drift does not become permanent.

options.title: Defer Public Hook API
options.body: Keep reaction automation on system events or external workarounds until maintainers are ready to sponsor a broader plugin-hook design.

recommendation.title: Approve Generic Observation Hooks
recommendation.body: Add reaction_added and reaction_removed as observation-only public hooks with a shared payload shape, then wire Discord first with tests and docs while leaving room for Slack, Matrix, and WhatsApp parity.

likelyOwner.reason: This is primarily a public plugin hook contract decision, and vincentkoc appears in recent hook context history as reviewer/coauthor while steipete is the likely Discord-path input owner.
